commandReceipts.command: cd kvstore-cli 2>/dev/null || cd .; cargo run -q -p kvstore-cli -- "put:k" 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "EXIT=$?"

output.claim: The `put` arm of handle_request panics on malformed untrusted wire input: `parts.next().unwrap()` (api.rs:26) panics when no key field is present, and `parts.next().unwrap().parse().unwrap()` (api.rs:27) panics on a missing or non-numeric ttl. A malformed request aborts the process instead of returning Response::Error, violating SPEC requirement 2 (REQ-002).
counterEvidenceChecked: kvstore/src/api.rs:16-17 — no length/arity check on `parts` before the `put` arm; `split(':')` on "put" yields exactly one element so the second `next()` is None, no upstream guard makes it unreachable

the sibling `get` arm at api.rs:18-24 does match on `parts.next()` and returns Response::Error("bad request") for None — the graceful path exists but is not applied to `put`, confirming the panic is not intended behavior
kvstore-cli/src/main.rs:7-9 — the only in-repo caller collects `std::env::args()` and passes each string straight to handle_request with no arity or numeric validation
grep for `handle_request` across the workspace — only kvstore/src/lib.rs:8 (re-export) and kvstore-cli/src/main.rs:9; no wrapper performs validation
grep for `#[test]` and `mod tests` across all .rs files — zero matches, so no existing test covers or documents malformed `put` input
kvstore/src/api.rs:12-14 doc comment explicitly states 'Wire requests are untrusted input', so the panic contradicts rather than documents intended behavior
docs/SPEC.md non-goals (lines 21-24) and open questions (26-28) — neither exempts the put path or permits process termination

evidence.command: kvstore-cli/src/main.rs:7-9 (argv -> handle_request, no validation) -> kvstore/src/api.rs:25 Some("put") -> api.rs:26 parts.next().unwrap() with request "put" (split(':') yields one item, second next() is None) -> panic
docs/SPEC.md:13-15 requirement 2 'Untrusted input': 'A malformed request must produce an error response; it must never terminate the process.'
fresh read of kvstore/src/api.rs:15-33 and kvstore-cli/src/main.rs:1-12 at revision cec312d

output.reason: Three unguarded unwraps at kvstore/src/api.rs:26-27 are reachable from any wire request beginning with `put` that lacks a key, lacks a ttl, or has a non-numeric ttl; kvstore-cli/src/main.rs:9 feeds argv in unvalidated, and the sibling `get` arm's None handling shows the error response was intended, so this directly violates SPEC requirement 2.
